citations.claim: first energy_bound violation: total energy exceeds allowed tolerance at step 4 with no controller work
initial energy baseline showing monotonic growth to violation
vertical velocity falls ~1.836 per step, ~6x larger than g*dt (~0.306), injecting spurious kinetic energy in free flight
energy already rising by step 3 with no walls, collisions or controller work

counterfactual.change: set gravity 9.81 to 0 with all else identical; free-flight energy stays exactly constant so no violation, proving gravity integration injects the excess energy

explanation: Single fast body in free flight (no walls, no controller, no collisions) gains total energy every step. vx is constant but vy drops by ~1.836 per dt=0.0312 step while g*dt predicts only ~0.306 (6x too much); positions advance correctly by v*dt, so the gravity velocity update over-applies. The excess kinetic energy outweighs the potential drop, producing monotonic energy growth from 6860.79 to 7551.94 and breaching energy_bound at step 4.
vision_note: A single circle moves very fast rightward across an empty arena with only a slight downward drop from step 1 to step 4. By step 4 it reaches near the right edge with no interior walls, waypoints, or collisions visible.
